messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

I've drafted the graph. It has the user, the web app, the users database, and the email service, which sits outside your app's zone. The flow runs in the order you described: the user asks for help, the app looks up the account, the email service sends the one-time link, and the user opens it and sets a new password. The app then saves the password to the users database and signs the user in.

Two assumptions to check:
- The new password is saved to the users database. If you keep credentials somewhere else, tell me.
- The web app handles the one-time link and the sign-in itself, with no separate auth service.

Is the graph right? If so, I'll agree the story with you next.
The graph looks good. I approve it.

The graph is approved. Before I write the script, here's the story I'd tell. Tell me if it's right.

- **Who it's for:** people who use the app, not its developers.
- **The one thing to remember:** a reset link works once, and only for an hour.
- **Shape:** problem, how it works, outcome.
- **Hook:** "Someone can't remember their password."

The flow runs from the forgotten password, through the account lookup and the one-time link, to a new password and a signed-in user. Should I save this and draft the script, or would you change anything first?
Yes, that story works for me. Go ahead and write the script.

The script is drafted: one scene, about 60 seconds. It opens on someone who can't remember their password and asks the app for help. It shows the account lookup and the one-time link, with a callout that the link expires after an hour or one use. It ends with the user choosing a new password and signed in. I shortened the opening line so it reads in time.

Suggested title card: "Forgot your password? Here's how we reset it", with the description "A reset link works once, and only for an hour."

Is the script right? If so, I can save the title card and any palette or end-card link you want, then point you to the Preview gate.
The script looks good. I approve it.

The script is approved, and the project is now at the style gate.

Do you want the suggested title card, "Forgot your password? Here's how we reset it", with the description "A reset link works once, and only for an hour."? I can also set a palette, or add an end card with a link and a QR code. If you want none of these, I'll leave the defaults and you can watch the video at the Preview gate.

input.request: Shorten beat 2 (the account lookup, id "find"): make its caption and narration shorter, keeping the same actions and meaning.
